claims.quote: Clinicians should not routinely prescribe antibiotics to treat dysphonia

claims.text: ⍉antireflux meds for isolated dysphonia on Sx alone w.o visualizing the larynx
claims.quote: Clinicians should not prescribe antireflux medications to treat isolated dysphonia, based on symptoms alone attributed to suspected gastroesophageal reflux disease
claims.locator: Stachler RJ, et al. Clinical Practice Guideline: Hoarseness (Dysphonia) (Update). Otolaryngol Head Neck Surg. 2018;158(1 Suppl):S1-S42 (abstract, PubMed)

claims.quote: Clinicians should not routinely prescribe corticosteroids for patients with dysphonia prior to visualization of the larynx
